distinguishing_fact: Subheading 7419.20.00 is restricted to articles that are cast, molded, stamped, or forged but not further worked; the subject brass snap hook is a finished assembly with a swiveling eye and safety snap mechanism.
reasoning: Under Note 5 to Section XV, an alloy of base metals is classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals. The brass snap hook (Model 225B) is composed of 61% copper, 35% zinc, and 4% other material; copper predominates, classifying the article in Chapter 74. Explanatory Notes to heading 74.19 cover articles listed in the ENs to heading 73.26, which include snap hooks. Because the item is an assembled hardware article with moving parts, it is further worked beyond casting/forging (excluding 7419.20) and falls under 7419.80. Within 7419.80, it is not wire cloth, a container, a spring, a chain, or plated with precious metal, leading to subheading 7419.80.50.
